# P03 Regulatory Gap Analysis: Cris Santos Company | Emergency Services | Enterprise

**Regulation to analyze:** HIPAA Security Rule, 45 CFR Part 164, Subpart C (164.302-164.318)
**Why:** Cris Santos Company is a private ambulance provider here, a HIPAA covered entity when it bills electronically, so the Security Rule binds it directly. Research note: the sector research chose the FBI CJIS Security Policy v6.1, which applies when the provider accesses criminal justice information (for example, through a shared CAD with law enforcement); treat it as secondary.
